//: Type checking WITHOUT TypeScript syntax. Plain .js files stay plain .js; types
come from JSDoc comments and inference, and nothing is emitted. This exists to
catch the class of bug that shipped on 2026-08-17: a refactor deleted a local
and left three reads of it behind, which is a runtime ReferenceError that no
amount of careful reading reliably catches.
SCOPE IS DELIBERATELY SMALL. It covers the shared, reusable JavaScript and the
build/test tooling. The ~1.1MB of inline tool JS living inside <script> tags in
the page templates is NOT reachable by tsc while it stays inline; moving those
out to ES modules, one tool at a time, is what widens this net.
